links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT recommendation strength across repeated runs
links.effect: Fleiss kappa was 0.409, indicating a moderate level of agreement across repeated runs A, B, and C.
links.quote: For the reliability of the strengths of the recommendation, the Fleiss kappa was 0.409, indicating a moderate level of agreement.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT recommendation strengths versus 2021 AAOS guidelines
links.effect: Accuracy 0.684, 0.579, 0.632 for outputs A, B, C; precision 0.740, 0.737, 0.718.
links.quote: Regarding the strengths of the recommendation compared with the 2021 AAOS guidelines, we observed accuracy of 0.684, 0.579, and 0.632 for outputs A, B, and C, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the reproducibility, reliability, and accuracy of ChatGPT (GPT-4 and GPT-4o) responses to guideline-based questions about hip fracture management without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
